result.summary: REWORK 1 re-validation PASS. All BLOCKER/MAJOR issues from cycle 0 are resolved. CDV-001: all 8 tables reclassified PER_TENANT; GBL-142 drops from public only via explicit public.%I EXECUTE — no tenant schema loop. CDV-002: 1145/1146/1148/1149 now use DO \$\$ + IF current_schema() = 'public' THEN RETURN early-exit (1147 pattern) — not -- scope: public. OQ-1 closed by ORCH (2026-08-12, documented in design Section 1 and Section 10). GBL-142 current_schema() != 'public' guard is correct defensive belt-and-suspenders for a GBL- migration. No tenant schema data is touched. Migration is idempotent (existence checks + IF NOT EXISTS). Design is unambiguous for BACKEND-DEV.

checks_passed: CDV-001 FIXED: All 8 tables PER_TENANT. GBL-142 drops public.<name> only via EXECUTE format('DROP TABLE public.%I RESTRICT', v_table) — no tenant schema loop.
CDV-002 FIXED: 1145/1146/1148/1149 all use DO \$\$ IF current_schema() = 'public' THEN RAISE NOTICE + RETURN early-exit. No -- scope: public anywhere.
OQ-1 CLOSED: Section 10 RESOLVED. Section 1 cites ORCH classification authority (2026-08-12).
GBL-142 guard IF current_schema() != 'public' THEN RETURN: correct defensive guard for GBL- migration; redundant with explicit public.%I schema qualification in EXECUTE.
Data loss in tenant schemas: NONE. Every DROP uses explicit public.%I qualification. No tenant_* schema ever referenced.
Idempotency: GBL-142 guarded by v_exists_pub AND v_exists_ten check per table; source patches use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.
Coverage: all 8 tables in v_tables array; all 4 source migrations patched (6a/6b/6c/6d); all OQs resolved or acknowledged in Section 10.
Error taxonomy: Section 7 covers dependent_objects_still_exist (EXCEPTION block), undefined_table (existence-check guard), 42501 insufficient_privilege (propagates).
Dependencies: Section 9 correct. No public.tenant loop, no application-state dependency, no other open corrective migration dependency.
